name: The Dark Prince

items.name: Dreadful Aura
items.text: The flagship of the Chelaxian navy exudes a malevolent air. At the beginning of their turns or when they enter the aura, enemy creatures on board the ship and enemy creatures within a 300-foot emanation who can see the ship must succeed at a DC 39 Will save save or become Frightened 1 (or Frightened 2 on a critical failure). Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune to this aura for 1 minute. However, an enemy creature on board can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 until it is no longer on board.

items.name: Weapon Mounts
items.text: This vehicle has 6 weapon mounts, three on each side of the vehicle. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful DC 40 Crafting check check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

text: A massive red-and-black warship, the Dark Prince sports an imposing figurehead of Asmodeus and terrifying faces carved along its gunwales. It patrols the area around the Arch of Aroden, keeping the waters free of pirates and enemies.
